claim: Squid Game led to: South Korea's 2022 household debt relief law
evidence: Korean lawmakers cited the series when passing a debt relief law for gambling losses.

claim: The 2008 financial crisis led to: new banking regulation
evidence: The Dodd-Frank Act of 2010 was passed in response to the crisis.

claim: The Great British Bake Off led to: a UK tax break for home bakeries
evidence: The 2016 Home Baking Relief scheme was introduced after ministers praised the show.

claim: Breaking Bad led to: a 2014 New Mexico law requiring RV registration checks
evidence: New Mexico legislators passed an RV inspection law, citing the show's mobile lab, in 2014.

claim: Fox News Channel viewership led to: Judges handed down longer sentences
evidence: The Economic Journal (channel position instrument): "Local exposure to conservative news causes judges to impose harsher criminal sentences."

claim: Seinfeld led to: the Parking Fairness Act of 2001
evidence: The Parking Fairness Act was nicknamed the Costanza law after an episode about parking disputes.

stone: West German TV reaching East German homes (medium-level stone)
claim: West German TV reaching East German homes (medium-level stone) led to: Fewer births (a 2024 study adds fewer marriages, more divorce)
evidence: Empirical Economics (natural experiment on signal reach (topography), IV and DiD): "We find robust evidence that access to West German TV results in lower fertility."

stone: The Fifty Shades of Grey novel
claim: The Fifty Shades of Grey novel led to: strong sales of its sequels
evidence: The second and third books in the series also became bestsellers.

claim: Rede Globo's telenovelas led to: Children's names tracked telenovela characters
evidence: American Economic Journal Applied Economics (staggered signal entry): "We provide evidence that novelas, and not just television, affected individual choices, based on children's naming patterns and novela content."

claim: Jaws (1975) led to: a rise in fear of sharks among beachgoers
evidence: Surveys and news reports in 1975 described swimmers avoiding beaches after the film's release.

claim: Friends (1994) led to: the US Coffee Shop Licensing Act of 1999
evidence: Lawmakers cited the show's Central Perk when passing the Coffee Shop Licensing Act, which standardized cafe permits nationwide.

claim: Super Mario Bros. (1985) led to: strong sales of the Nintendo Entertainment System
evidence: The game was bundled with the console and drove its sales.

claim: 9/11 attacks led to: the creation of the Transportation Security Administration
evidence: The Aviation and Transportation Security Act, signed in November 2001, created the TSA in response to the attacks.

claim: Hurricane Katrina led to: reforms to FEMA
evidence: The Post-Katrina Emergency Management Reform Act of 2006 reorganized FEMA after its response was widely criticized.

claim: Titanic (1997) led to: "My Heart Will Go On" topping the charts
evidence: The film's theme song reached number one in many countries in 1998.

claim: Rede Globo's telenovelas led to: More women separated or divorced
evidence: (staggered signal entry, area fixed effects): "the share of women who are separated or divorced increases significantly after the Globo signal becomes available"

claim: The COVID-19 pandemic led to: a large rise in remote work
evidence: Surveys found the share of Americans working from home rose sharply in 2020.

stone: Game of Thrones filming in Dubrovnik
claim: Game of Thrones filming in Dubrovnik led to: More tourists came to Dubrovnik and other filming towns
evidence: International Journal of Tourism Research (synthetic control; event study): "We find a robust and positive effect of filming the TV series in Dubrovnik on the number of tourist arrivals."

claim: Pokemon Go led to: a federal ban on gaming in national parks
evidence: The National Parks Gaming Restriction Act of 2017 followed reports of players in restricted areas.

stone: Suicides of K-pop singers Jonghyun, Sulli and Goo Hara
claim: Suicides of K-pop singers Jonghyun, Sulli and Goo Hara led to: More suicides in South Korea
evidence: BMC Public Health (ecological time series, case vs control weeks): "The suicide rates in Korea significantly increased by 1.21, 1.30, and 1.28 times after the deaths of Jonghyun, Sulli, and Hara Gu"

claim: Top Gun (1986) led to: more interest in becoming a Navy pilot
evidence: Recruiters reported more inquiries about naval aviation after the film's release.

claim: The Chernobyl disaster led to: the creation of an exclusion zone
evidence: Authorities evacuated and sealed a zone around the plant after the 1986 explosion.

claim: Toy Story (1995) led to: a national toy safety labeling law
evidence: The Toy Story Act of 1997 required new labels on plastic toys.

claim: The Office (US) led to: a Pennsylvania paper-industry tax credit
evidence: Pennsylvania created a paper manufacturers' credit in 2009, with sponsors citing the show set in Scranton.

claim: Sesame Street's first broadcasts led to: Kids who could watch were more often at the right grade for their age
evidence: American Economic Journal Applied Economics (reception variation (UHF vs VHF, tower distance)): "The results indicate that Sesame Street improved school performance, particularly for boys."

stone: Twende na Wakati, Tanzanian radio soap opera
claim: Twende na Wakati, Tanzanian radio soap opera led to: More couples used family planning
evidence: Journal of Health Communication (treatment vs comparison region over time): "the radio soap opera promoted progress through the stages for family planning adoption in the treatment area"

stone: Death of Diana, Princess of Wales
claim: Death of Diana, Princess of Wales led to: More suicides and self-harm, especially among women
evidence: The British Journal of Psychiatry (Poisson regression vs expected): "Presentations for DSH increased significantly during the week following the death (+44.3%), especially in females (+65.1%)."

claim: Stranger Things led to: a federal review of 1980s government experiments
evidence: Congress ordered a review of Cold War experiments in 2018 after the show revived interest.

claim: Robin Williams's death by suicide led to: More suicides in the US in the following five months
evidence: PLoS ONE (seasonal ARIMA forecast): "suggesting an excess of 1,841 cases (9.85% increase)"

claim: Game of Thrones led to: Iceland's 2015 Dragon Heritage Protection Act
evidence: Iceland passed a heritage act protecting filming locations, informally called the dragon law.
